items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Isidro Prince played with him too, yes.

ctx.x: Prince. During those days, I can recall, the band didn't parade like they parade now, you know, the band's riding what you call it, Cattleho, you know? The band's riding and riding and playing the parades, you know? Oh yeah, they played parades, I was a boy, but I don't remember. They seen Bunk Johnson. Bunk Johnson played parades over there. Bunk, you know? Yeah, sure.
They ride, what do you mean, they ride in a truck?
